gammes.title: Light without shadows
gammes.body: The membrane diffuses the LED light across its whole surface: no harsh spots, no dark corners, an even glow that fills the room.

gammes.title: Colours you control
gammes.body: Warm white for everyday life, dynamic colours for a mood — brightness and hue are driven from your phone.

gammes.title: A clean, fast install
gammes.body: The aluminium frame mounts to your existing ceiling and the membrane is stretched in a day. No demolition, no dust.

pourquoi.title: Welded in our workshop
pourquoi.body: Every frame is TIG-welded in the workshop, fitted to your room's exact dimensions.

pourquoi.title: One point of contact
pourquoi.body: From measurements to installation, you talk to the maker — not a reseller.

pourquoi.title: Truly custom
pourquoi.body: Shapes, sizes, light temperatures: the ceiling is designed for your space, never the other way round.

artisanat.title: Handmade furniture
artisanat.subtitle: Wood & steel furniture, designed and welded by hand in our workshop. Small batches, fixed prices, delivered across France.
artisanat.craftBandBody: Every piece leaves our own workshop: the wood is picked board by board, the steel is TIG-welded then powder-coated, and final assembly is done by hand. No industrial runs — your furniture is made for you, to order.
artisanat.faqDeliveryQ: What are the making and delivery times?
artisanat.faqDeliveryA: Each piece is made to order: allow 4 to 8 weeks depending on the item, then delivery across mainland France with assembly included. We propose a precise slot as soon as your piece is ready.
artisanat.faqCareQ: How do I care for a wood & steel piece?
artisanat.faqCareA: A soft dry cloth day to day. For oiled wood, re-apply hardwax oil once a year; scratches sand out lightly. Powder-coated steel wipes clean with a damp sponge — no abrasives.

apropos.title: About
apropos.histoireBody: Auboiacier contracts Aumercier, bois (wood) and acier (steel). Behind the workshop is a welder-metalworker with over five years across sites and workshops, in France and then in Australia with a specialist in backlit stretch ceilings. Back in France, the workshop brings both worlds together: the precision of metal, the warmth of wood and light.
apropos.savoirFaireBody: TIG, MAG and SMAW welding, aluminium frames fitted to the millimetre, stretched membranes, solid-wood tops: every step happens in the workshop, from cutting to finishing. That is what lets us stand behind every piece we deliver.

valeurs.title: Custom first
valeurs.body: Every piece starts from your space and your use — never from a catalogue.

valeurs.title: Honest materials
valeurs.body: Solid wood, solid steel, visible welds: nothing veneered, nothing hidden.

valeurs.title: Work we stand behind
valeurs.body: Made and installed by the same hands, and supported over time.
